exercise.neck_rolls.name: Neck Rolls
exercise.neck_rolls.description: Gentle circular neck movements to warm up the neck muscles
exercise.neck_rolls.tips: Move slowly and smoothly. Stop if you feel pain.
exercise.arm_circles.name: Arm Circles
exercise.arm_circles.description: Circular arm movements to warm up shoulders
exercise.arm_circles.tips: Start small, gradually increase circle size.
exercise.squat.name: Squat
exercise.squat.description: Lower body strength exercise targeting legs and glutes
exercise.squat.tips: Keep your chest up, knees behind toes, and weight in your heels.
exercise.reverse_lunge.name: Reverse Lunge
exercise.reverse_lunge.description: Step back and lower into a lunge position
exercise.reverse_lunge.tips: Keep your front knee behind your toes. Engage your core.
exercise.push_up.name: Push-up
exercise.push_up.description: Upper body pressing movement targeting chest, shoulders, and triceps
exercise.push_up.tips: Keep your body in a straight line. Lower until chest nearly touches ground.
exercise.chair_dip.name: Chair Dip
exercise.chair_dip.description: Triceps exercise using a chair for support
exercise.chair_dip.tips: Keep elbows pointing back, not out. Lower until elbows are 90 degrees.
exercise.plank.name: Plank
exercise.plank.description: Isometric core exercise holding a push-up position
exercise.plank.tips: Keep your body straight from head to heels. Don't let hips sag.
exercise.glute_bridge.name: Glute Bridge
exercise.glute_bridge.description: Hip extension exercise targeting glutes and core
exercise.glute_bridge.tips: Squeeze glutes at the top. Keep core engaged throughout.
exercise.jumping_jacks.name: Jumping Jacks
exercise.jumping_jacks.description: Full body cardio exercise with jumping and arm movements
exercise.jumping_jacks.tips: Land softly on your toes. Keep a steady rhythm.
exercise.high_knees.name: High Knees
exercise.high_knees.description: Running in place while lifting knees high
exercise.high_knees.tips: Lift knees to hip height. Pump your arms for momentum.
exercise.cat_cow.name: Cat-Cow
exercise.cat_cow.description: On hands and knees, alternately round and arch your spine to loosen the back
exercise.cat_cow.tips: Move with your breath: exhale as you round, inhale as you arch. Keep your arms straight.
exercise.hip_flexor_stretch.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercise.hip_flexor_stretch.description: Kneel on one knee and shift your hips forward to stretch the front of the back hip
exercise.hip_flexor_stretch.tips: Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg and keep your torso upright. Pad the knee if needed.
exercise.hamstring_stretch.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
exercise.hamstring_stretch.description: Hinge forward with straight legs and reach toward your shins to stretch the back of the legs
exercise.hamstring_stretch.tips: Bend from the hips, not the lower back. Stop at a gentle stretch, never bounce.
exercise.hip_hinge.name: Hip Hinge
exercise.hip_hinge.description: Push your hips back with a flat back, then stand tall, hands on hips
exercise.hip_hinge.tips: Keep a soft bend in the knees and your back flat. Squeeze your glutes to stand up.
exercise.calf_raise.name: Calf Raise
exercise.calf_raise.description: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, then lower your heels slowly
exercise.calf_raise.tips: Pause at the top. Hold a wall or chair for balance if needed.
exercise.reverse_snow_angel.name: Reverse Snow Angel
exercise.reverse_snow_angel.description: Lying face down, sweep your arms from your hips to overhead, just above the floor
exercise.reverse_snow_angel.tips: Keep your forehead down and thumbs up. Move slowly and keep the arms off the floor.
exercise.superman.name: Superman
exercise.superman.description: Lying face down, lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together
exercise.superman.tips: Lift only a few centimetres. Look at the floor to keep your neck long.
exercise.bird_dog.name: Bird Dog
exercise.bird_dog.description: On hands and knees, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, then switch
exercise.bird_dog.tips: Keep your hips level and your back flat. Move slowly, don't rush the switch.
exercise.dead_bug.name: Dead Bug
exercise.dead_bug.description: On your back, lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor, then switch
exercise.dead_bug.tips: Press your lower back into the floor the whole time. Breathe out as you lower.
exercise.side_plank.name: Side Plank
exercise.side_plank.description: Hold your body in a straight line on one forearm and the side of your feet
exercise.side_plank.tips: Stack your elbow under your shoulder and keep your hips lifted. Switch sides each set.
exercise.mountain_climbers.name: Mountain Climbers
exercise.mountain_climbers.description: From a high plank, drive your knees toward your chest one at a time
exercise.mountain_climbers.tips: Keep your hips low and your hands under your shoulders. Start slow, then speed up.
exercise.torso_twist.name: Torso Twist
exercise.torso_twist.description: Stand tall with elbows bent and turn your upper body from side to side
exercise.torso_twist.tips: Keep your hips facing forward and turn from the waist. Move smoothly, don't swing.
exercise.side_bend.name: Standing Side Bend
exercise.side_bend.description: Reach one arm overhead and lean to the opposite side, then switch
exercise.side_bend.tips: Bend straight to the side, not forward. Keep both feet planted.
exercise.hip_circles.name: Hip Circles
exercise.hip_circles.description: Hands on hips, draw slow circles with your hips in both directions
exercise.hip_circles.tips: Keep your shoulders still and knees soft. Switch direction halfway.
exercise.childs_pose.name: Child's Pose
exercise.childs_pose.description: Kneel, sit back on your heels and reach your arms forward along the floor
exercise.childs_pose.tips: Let your chest sink toward the floor and breathe slowly. Spread your knees if it feels tight.
exercise.knee_to_chest.name: Knee-to-Chest Stretch
exercise.knee_to_chest.description: Lying on your back, hug both knees to your chest to ease the lower back
exercise.knee_to_chest.tips: Keep your head and shoulders on the floor. Breathe slowly and let your back relax.
exercise.wall_sit.name: Wall Sit
exercise.wall_sit.description: Slide down a wall until your thighs are near parallel and hold
exercise.wall_sit.tips: Keep your back flat on the wall and knees above your ankles. Go only as low as is comfortable.
exercise.sumo_squat.name: Sumo Squat
exercise.sumo_squat.description: Squat with feet wide and toes turned out
exercise.sumo_squat.tips: Push your knees out over your toes and keep your chest up.
exercise.step_up.name: Step-Up
exercise.step_up.description: Step up onto a stair with one foot, stand tall, then step back down
exercise.step_up.tips: Push through the heel of the top foot. Hold the rail if you need balance.
exercise.side_lunge.name: Side Lunge
exercise.side_lunge.description: Step wide to the side and sit back into that hip, other leg straight
exercise.side_lunge.tips: Keep your chest up and the bent knee over your toes. Push back to the centre.
exercise.donkey_kick.name: Donkey Kick
exercise.donkey_kick.description: On hands and knees, lift one bent leg so the sole of the foot rises toward the ceiling
exercise.donkey_kick.tips: Keep your back flat and hips level. Squeeze your glute at the top.
exercise.incline_push_up.name: Incline Push-Up
exercise.incline_push_up.description: A push-up with your hands on the seat of a sturdy chair
exercise.incline_push_up.tips: Brace the chair against a wall. Keep your body in a straight line.
exercise.wall_angel.name: Wall Angel
exercise.wall_angel.description: With your back against a wall, slide your arms up and down like a snow angel
exercise.wall_angel.tips: Keep your lower back, elbows and wrists close to the wall. Move slowly.
exercise.crunch.name: Crunch
exercise.crunch.description: Lying on your back with knees bent, curl your shoulders off the floor
exercise.crunch.tips: Lift with your abs, not your neck. Breathe out as you curl up.
exercise.bicycle_crunch.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercise.bicycle_crunch.description: On your back, bring each elbow toward the opposite knee while the other leg extends
exercise.bicycle_crunch.tips: Turn from the ribs, not the elbows. Keep it slow and controlled.
exercise.plank_shoulder_tap.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
exercise.plank_shoulder_tap.description: In a high plank, tap each shoulder with the opposite hand
exercise.plank_shoulder_tap.tips: Spread your feet wider for balance and keep your hips still.
exercise.march_in_place.name: March in Place
exercise.march_in_place.description: March on the spot, lifting your knees and swinging your arms
exercise.march_in_place.tips: A quiet way to raise your heart rate. Stand tall and keep a steady pace.
exercise.standing_cross_crunch.name: Standing Cross Crunch
exercise.standing_cross_crunch.descripti: Bring one knee up to meet the opposite elbow, then switch
exercise.standing_cross_crunch.tips: Twist from your waist and keep your standing leg soft.
exercise.butt_kicks.name: Butt Kicks
exercise.butt_kicks.description: Jog in place, kicking your heels up toward your glutes
exercise.butt_kicks.tips: Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees pointing down.
exercise.leg_swings.name: Leg Swings
exercise.leg_swings.description: Swing one straight leg forward and back like a pendulum, then switch
exercise.leg_swings.tips: Hold a wall for balance if you need it. Keep your torso upright and let the swing grow gradually.
exercise.cobra_stretch.name: Cobra Stretch
exercise.cobra_stretch.description: Lying face down, press through your hands to lift your chest and arch your back
exercise.cobra_stretch.tips: Keep your hips on the floor and your shoulders away from your ears. Rise only as far as feels comfortable.
exercise.standing_quad_stretch.name: Standing Quad Stretch
exercise.standing_quad_stretch.descripti: Stand on one leg and pull the other heel toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh
exercise.standing_quad_stretch.tips: Keep your knees together and your hips pushed forward. Hold a wall for balance if you need it.
exercise.split_squat.name: Split Squat
exercise.split_squat.description: Stand in a long stride and lower your back knee toward the floor, then rise
exercise.split_squat.tips: Keep your feet in place the whole set. Your front knee stays over your ankle.
exercise.curtsy_lunge.name: Curtsy Lunge
exercise.curtsy_lunge.description: Step one leg diagonally behind the other and bend both knees, like a curtsy
exercise.curtsy_lunge.tips: Keep your hips facing forward and your front knee in line with your toes.
exercise.fire_hydrant.name: Fire Hydrant
exercise.fire_hydrant.description: On hands and knees, lift one bent knee out to the side, then lower it
exercise.fire_hydrant.tips: Keep your back flat and your hips level. Move from the hip, not the waist.
exercise.single_leg_glute_bridge.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercise.single_leg_glute_bridge.descrip: Lying on your back with one leg extended, lift your hips by pushing through the planted foot
exercise.single_leg_glute_bridge.tips: Keep your hips level as you rise. Squeeze your glute at the top.
exercise.standing_hip_abduction.name: Standing Hip Abduction
exercise.standing_hip_abduction.descript: Standing tall, lift one straight leg out to the side, then lower it with control
exercise.standing_hip_abduction.tips: Keep your toes pointing forward and your torso upright. Hold a wall for balance if you need it.
exercise.wall_push_up.name: Wall Push-up
exercise.wall_push_up.description: Push-up with your hands on a wall, the gentlest push-up variation
exercise.wall_push_up.tips: Keep your body straight from head to heels. Step further from the wall to make it harder.
exercise.knee_push_up.name: Knee Push-up
exercise.knee_push_up.description: Push-up from your knees instead of your toes
exercise.knee_push_up.tips: Keep a straight line from your knees to your head. Lower your chest between your hands.
exercise.pike_push_up.name: Pike Push-up
exercise.pike_push_up.description: With hips high in an upside-down V, bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor
exercise.pike_push_up.tips: Keep your hips high and your elbows angled back. Lower slowly and stop before your head touches the floor.
exercise.reverse_crunch.name: Reverse Crunch
exercise.reverse_crunch.description: Lying on your back with knees bent, curl your hips off the floor toward your chest
exercise.reverse_crunch.tips: Move slowly and use your abs, not momentum. Lower your hips with control.
exercise.lying_leg_raise.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercise.lying_leg_raise.description: Lying on your back, raise both straight legs toward the ceiling, then lower them slowly
exercise.lying_leg_raise.tips: Press your lower back into the floor. Lower only as far as you can keep it there.
exercise.flutter_kicks.name: Flutter Kicks
exercise.flutter_kicks.description: Lying on your back with legs raised slightly, kick them up and down in small, quick movements
exercise.flutter_kicks.tips: Keep your lower back pressed to the floor and your legs straight. Raise them higher to make it easier.
exercise.heel_taps.name: Heel Taps
exercise.heel_taps.description: Lying on your back with shoulders lifted, reach side to side to tap each heel
exercise.heel_taps.tips: Keep your shoulders off the floor the whole set. Bend sideways from your waist.
exercise.russian_twist.name: Russian Twist
exercise.russian_twist.description: Seated and leaning back, rotate your torso from side to side with your hands together
exercise.russian_twist.tips: Keep your chest up and your back straight. Turn your shoulders, not just your arms.
exercise.shadow_boxing.name: Shadow Boxing
exercise.shadow_boxing.description: Throw alternating straight punches in a boxing stance
exercise.shadow_boxing.tips: Keep your fists near your face between punches and turn your hips with each one. Don't lock your elbows.
exercise.step_touch.name: Step Touch
exercise.step_touch.description: Step side to side, bringing your feet together each time, with an easy arm swing
exercise.step_touch.tips: Stay light on your feet and keep a steady rhythm. A quiet way to raise your heart rate.
exercise.arm_swings.name: Arm Swings
exercise.arm_swings.description: Swing straight arms open wide, then cross them in front of the chest like a hug
exercise.arm_swings.tips: Keep the swing relaxed and let it grow a little each time. Stand tall and keep your back still.
exercise.chest_opener.name: Chest Opener Stretch
exercise.chest_opener.description: Clasp your hands behind your back and lift your chest to stretch the front of the shoulders
exercise.chest_opener.tips: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and keep your chin level. Great after long hours at a desk.
exercise.calf_stretch.name: Wall Calf Stretch
exercise.calf_stretch.description: Hands on a wall, one foot back with the heel down, lean in to stretch the back calf
exercise.calf_stretch.tips: Keep the back leg straight and its heel on the floor. Switch legs halfway through.
exercise.butterfly_stretch.name: Butterfly Stretch
exercise.butterfly_stretch.description: Sit with the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall open
exercise.butterfly_stretch.tips: Sit tall and hold your feet. Lean forward from the hips only as far as feels comfortable.
exercise.inchworm.name: Inchworm
exercise.inchworm.description: Fold forward, walk your hands out to a high plank, then walk them back and stand up
exercise.inchworm.tips: Bend your knees as much as you need to reach the floor. Keep your hips steady in the plank.
exercise.forward_lunge.name: Forward Lunge
exercise.forward_lunge.description: Step forward and lower both knees to about 90 degrees, then push back to standing
exercise.forward_lunge.tips: Land heel first and keep your front knee over your ankle. Keep your torso upright.
exercise.single_leg_deadlift.name: Single-Leg Deadlift
exercise.single_leg_deadlift.description: Balance on one leg and hinge forward while the other leg reaches back
exercise.single_leg_deadlift.tips: Keep your back flat and your hips level. Go only as low as you can stay balanced.
exercise.clamshell.name: Clamshell
exercise.clamshell.description: Lie on your side with knees bent and open the top knee while the feet stay together
exercise.clamshell.tips: Don't let your hips roll back. Move slowly and squeeze at the top.
exercise.side_lying_leg_raise.name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
exercise.side_lying_leg_raise.descriptio: Lie on your side and lift the straight top leg, then lower it with control
exercise.side_lying_leg_raise.tips: Keep the top leg in line with your body and the toes pointing forward. Don't swing it.
exercise.decline_push_up.name: Decline Push-up
exercise.decline_push_up.description: Push-up with your feet raised on a chair or stair
exercise.decline_push_up.tips: Keep your body in one straight line and don't let your hips sag. A lower step makes it easier.
exercise.diamond_push_up.name: Diamond Push-up
exercise.diamond_push_up.description: Push-up with your hands close together under the chest
exercise.diamond_push_up.tips: Keep your elbows close to your sides. Drop to your knees if you can't keep good form.
exercise.prone_y_raise.name: Prone Y Raise
exercise.prone_y_raise.description: Lie face down with arms overhead in a Y and lift them off the floor
exercise.prone_y_raise.tips: Lead with your thumbs and pull your shoulder blades down and back. Keep your neck long.
exercise.hollow_body_hold.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercise.hollow_body_hold.description: On your back, lift your shoulders and straight legs off the floor and hold
exercise.hollow_body_hold.tips: Press your lower back into the floor. Bend your knees or lift your legs higher to make it easier.
exercise.toe_reach.name: Toe Reach
exercise.toe_reach.description: On your back with legs straight up, curl up and reach your hands toward your toes
exercise.toe_reach.tips: Lift with your abs, not your neck. Breathe out as you reach.
exercise.side_plank_hip_dip.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
exercise.side_plank_hip_dip.description: From a side plank, lower your hip toward the floor and lift it back up
exercise.side_plank_hip_dip.tips: Keep your elbow under your shoulder. Do both sides.
exercise.bear_plank.name: Bear Plank
exercise.bear_plank.description: On hands and toes, hover your knees just off the floor and hold
exercise.bear_plank.tips: Keep your back flat and your knees under your hips. Breathe steadily.
exercise.front_kicks.name: Front Kicks
exercise.front_kicks.description: Kick each leg forward to hip height in turn while the arms swing
exercise.front_kicks.tips: Kick with control, not force. Stand tall and land softly.
exercise.step_jacks.name: Step Jacks
exercise.step_jacks.description: Low-impact jumping jacks: step one foot out as the arms rise, then step back in
exercise.step_jacks.tips: Alternate sides each rep and reach the arms fully overhead. A quiet jumping jack.
